text: maria: Hey team — pushed an updated patch for the latency panel in Figma. Main changes: p95 tooltip wording, heatmap legend density, sampling dropdown microcopy, and keyboard focus order for the timepicker. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz jack: Looks great. Quick note: p95 tooltip currently says 'p95 latency' — can we change to 'p95 response latency (ms)'? More explicit for folks skimming the dashboard. lili: a11y nit: the lowest heatmap swatch fails contrast at small sizes (below 4.5:1). We should either use a patterned fill or add a border to increase perceptibility. samir: +1 on contrast. Also repro'd a keyboard nav bug: Tab skips the 'Apply' button in the time range picker on Safari. I can capture a short recording. aria-design: For sampling microcopy, 'Low / Medium / High' is ambiguous. Suggest 'Light (fast, lower fidelity)', 'Balanced (default)', 'Heavy (detailed, slower)'. Keep it concise. jack: I like that. Can we prefix with the control label: 'Sampling: Light (fast, lower fidelity)' so it's clear in the settings panel? maria: Sounds good. Tooltip/hover text should also explain the tradeoff in one sentence: 'Sampling reduces stored events to improve rendering and reduce cost.' Maybe include an inline link to docs. lili: And for screen readers we should add an aria-describedby to the sampling dropdown that points to a hidden explainer paragraph. samir: here's a quick snippet for the aria pattern: ```html Light sampling reduces per-request events to 1 in 10, may hide rare spikes. ``` aria-design: UX flow thought: when a user changes sampling, surface a transient toast: 'Sampling updated — current view reflects the new rate' with a 'Re-run' action so users can immediately refresh with the new setting. maria: Also thinking about the p95 tooltip: show p50 / p95 numbers inline plus a tiny sparkline to indicate distribution. Any perf concerns about rendering sparklines in tooltips? samir: Sparklines are cheap if rendered at the chart level (prebaked canvas) rather than building new DOM/SVG each tooltip render. We can reuse a single tiny canvas sprite. jack: Minor copy tweak for presets: prefer 'Last hour' instead of 'Last 1h', and 'Last day' vs 'Last 24h' — friendlier for non-engineering audiences. aria-design: Proposal for keyboard focus order in the timepicker: 1) Date inputs, 2) Presets, 3) Apply button, 4) Sampling dropdown. Thoughts? lili: I worry putting presets between date inputs and Apply might be surprising. Alternative: Presets first, then date inputs, then Apply. We should prototype both and run a quick 5-person test. maria: Good idea — I'll prototype both flows in Figma and schedule a short hallway test tomorrow. dev-bot: Deploy preview created for branch ui/latency-panel/feat-axes — staging: https://staging.redwood/123 maria: Sweet, if no objections by EOD I'll merge and open follow-up tickets for the a11y fixes and the toast behavior. jack: :thumbsup:
